daily.today_energy: Your energy is giving balance meets breakthrough. Mercury's whispering something about embracing your duality instead of fighting it. This is your reminder that being multifaceted isn't chaos—it's your superpower.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, there's a gentle invitation to be more authentic today. Drop the people-pleasing mask for a sec. The right people are drawn to your realness, not your perfectly curated version.
daily.career: That project you've been hesitant about? The universe is nudging you toward it. Your diplomatic nature is exactly what's needed right now. Trust that your voice matters and deserves space at the table.
daily.health: Your body's asking for intentional movement today—nothing intense, just something that feels good. Whether that's a walk, stretching, or dancing in your room, tune into what your system actually craves instead of forcing a routine.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about recalibrating your vibe. Mercury's got you thinking deeply about what you actually want versus what you think you should want. Trust the quiet knowing.
weekly.love: Someone's energy is shifting around you and it's giving clarity. Whether you're coupled up or solo, this is about getting real with yourself about what genuine connection looks like for you.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. Don't sleep on that thing you've been thinking about—the universe is basically saying it's your time to speak up and be seen doing your thing.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for slower, more intentional movement. Think less hustle, more alignment. Listen to what feels good instead of what sounds productive. Your nervous system will thank you.
